column3: MT 92:1–2; the following verses of this psalm are MT +1. Close to the Hebrew.
Close to the Hebrew; “on a ten, on a lyre, on a melody with harp” is rendered “On an instrument of ten strings, On the lute, And on the harp, With harmonious sound.”
Close to the Hebrew; אֲרַנֵּן (“I sing for joy”) is rendered “I will triumph.”
Close to the Hebrew; כְּמוֹ עֵשֶׂב (“like herbage”) is rendered “like grass.”
Close to the Hebrew; מָרוֹם (“[are] on high”) is rendered “are on high.”
Close to the Hebrew; NKJV supplies “my desire” twice.
Close to the Hebrew; דְּשֵׁנִים (“fat”) is rendered “fresh,” and “fresh” “flourishing.”
